draw.description: Four clicks create the first quad. Further faces reuse the active border.

select.description: Gold selected edges persist when you switch tools.

strips.description: Stroke release creates geometry automatically; orange handles can reshape it.

strokes.description: A second compatible rail creates quads between the two rails.

patches.description: A green patch preview is confirmed with Enter.

connect.description: New quads reuse the selected seam vertices exactly.

contours.description: A second closed section creates a quad band automatically.

loops.description: Hover feedback identifies the affected loop before insertion or sliding.

tweak.description: The brush circle shows the influence radius before the stroke.

relax.description: Local brush passes respect the source surface and protected vertices.
